releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.12 - Android Auto & Dedicated Car Mode
releaseNotes: Milestone 3 Item 7: Android Auto vehicle integration & high-contrast in-app Car Mode. Exposes music library directly to automotive head units (All Tracks, Playlists, Favorites, Recently Added) via MediaLibraryService and automotive_app_desc.xml. Features dedicated distraction-free CarModeActivity with 78dp touch targets, keep-screen-on wake lock, tactile haptic feedback, and in-dash voice search.
